def binary_search(array, element):
    """
    Binary Search
    Complexity: O(logN)

    Requires a sorted array.
    Small modifications needed to work
    with descending order as well.
    """
    lower = 0
    upper = len(array) - 1

    while lower <= upper:
        mid = (lower+upper) // 2
        if array[mid] < element:
            lower = mid + 1
        elif array[mid] > element:
            upper = mid - 1
        else:
            return mid

    return -1
